Overview

Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Vengeful Swordsman

Evolving

Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) can be evolved from Vengeful Swordsman with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Spellforged Blades

Attacks from Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) also deal his damage as additional Magic damage. Buffs to Physical damage apply to his Magic damage as well.

This means he does x2 his displayed damage

Passive Ability: White Flash Draw Technique

The first hit against an enemy will have + 100% Critical Chance and penetrate 60% of enemy Physical and Magic Resistances (If they have ones)

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Despite stating to penetrate 60% of Physical and Magic Resistances it has been proven he only penetrates 40%
  • Its possible get a Double Crit in his first hit (x2.5 instead of x1.5) if you have a base crit chance.
  • Gambler (Jackpot) gives both types of Crit Chance (magic and physical) to Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver)
    • For some reason is impossible to get a Double Magic Crit despite Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) having a base magic Crit Chance
  • Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) can be buffed by Elfy (Sylph) or Wind Dragon and Commander at the same time, however, elfy or wind dragon will only buff his Magic damage.
  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
